senses.gloss:
युष्मद् युष्मद्, pronoun of the second person, Thou; the bases of the cases are त्व, तु, युव, यु, युष्म, i. e. यु + स्म, and त, व. Ved. nom. du. युवम्, Chr. 295, 17 = Rigv. i. 92, 17; gen., abl. युवोस्, 296, 2 = Rigv. i. 112, 2.
 --Cf. Lat. tu, te, vos; τούν, τύ, σύ, τέ, σέ, σϕῶι, ὔμμες; Goth. thu, jus, izvis; A.S. thu, gyt, eow.
युष्मादृश् युष्मादृश्, i. e. युष्मद्-दृश्, adj. Like you, Lass. 76, 4.
† यूष् यूष्, i. 1, Par. To hurt.

यूष यूष, m. and n. Pease soup. [] the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled.
 --Cf. Lat. jus; probably also ζωμός, ζύθος.
